sn28.3:1.3: vippasannāni kho te āvuso sāriputta, indriyāni, parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto.
sn28.3:2.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso, pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharāmi, sato ca sampajāno sukhaṃ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi
